form.no_types: No types available. Please configure a template first.
form.no_config: No additional configuration for this provider type.
form.type_not_in_template: Provider type {{type}} is not in the template list. You can continue using it or select another type.
form.error_matcher_placeholder:
Example (one per line or semicolon-separated):
"status":"439"
"status":"500"
API Token has expired
form.error_matcher_hint: Any matched sample is treated as an error. Useful for channels that return errors with HTTP 200.
form.name_hint: The name supports letters, digits, and - _ . only, must start with a letter or digit, and is limited to 64 characters. The name is also used as the path segment of the dedicated URL.
form.name_unsafe: The current name contains unsupported characters and cannot be used in a dedicated URL. It still works for model bindings, but no dedicated URL will be available.
form.forward_mode_mixed_desc: Known endpoints (chat, completions, etc.) are load-balanced across all providers; all other paths are forwarded to this provider as-is, with bound model names rewritten automatically.
form.forward_mode_pure_desc: All requests are forwarded unconditionally to this provider without modification; clients must use the provider's native model names directly.
form.forward_mode_hint: Both modes require an access key. Forward-only mode is not model-aware, so only keys with permission to all models may use it.
